propositions: Live DC harness must render pushed rich-text bodies (markdown→wiki) and assert rendered HTML via ?expand=renderedFields contains expected bold/heading/code-macro markup (h1/b/pre tags), not just wiki source

State-based echo-safety: a second reconcile pass after pushing a rich body to live Jira must compute zero inbound mutations (no re-push), proving the converged description decodes to itself across the codec+renderer
Both-sides concurrent edit under DC rich cutover must keep rebar's edited description (local-wins) and emit deduped outbound-field-conflict bridge alert, with remote value recorded not clobbered

InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text must maintain stable signature and behavior across versions so breaking changes to the function break the cross-repo contract test before agentic-dev-platform import fails
Inbound differ must treat Jira's echoed description as unchanged when it matches the local body's landed wire form (codec-aware echo-suppression), mirroring outbound _baseline_form_matches behavior
Rich-text cutover enablement (REBAR_RECONCILER_RICH_TEXT_CUTOVER=dc) must be set in the live test environment so WikiTextCodec performs markdown→wiki conversion instead of identity pass-through
